10	type RouterOption func(*handler)
11	
12	func WithPublisher(p EventPublisher) RouterOption {
13		return func(h *handler) { h.publisher = p }
14	}
15	
16	func NewRouter(store Storage, logger *slog.Logger, opts ...RouterOption) http.Handler {
17		apiMux := http.NewServeMux()
18	
19		h := &handler{store: store, hub: newWSHub(), logger: logger}
20		for _, opt := range opts {
21			opt(h)
22		}
23	
24		apiMux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/events", h.handleIngestEvents)
25		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/overview", h.handleOverview)
26		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/projects", h.handleListProjects)
27		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/projects/{id}/stats", h.handleProjectStats)
28		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/savings/trend", h.handleSavingsTrend)
29		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/waste", h.handleWasteReport)
30		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/waste/projects", h.handleProjectWasteScores)
31		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/security/alerts", h.handleSecurityAlerts)
32		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/billing/status", h.handleBillingStatus)
33		apiMux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/billing/checkout", h.handleCreateCheckout)
34		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/export/csv", h.handleExportCSV)
35		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/roi", h.handleROISummary)
36		apiMux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/ws", h.handleWebSocket)
37	
38		rl := newRateLimiter()
39	
40		var wrapped http.Handler = apiMux
41		wrapped = withRateLimit(rl)(wrapped)
42		wrapped = withTenantAuth(wrapped)
43		wrapped = withCORS(wrapped)
44	
45		root := http.NewServeMux()
46		root.HandleFunc("GET /healthz", h.handleHealthz)
47		root.HandleFunc("POST /v1/billing/webhook", h.handleStripeWebhook)
48		root.Handle("/", wrapped)
49	
50		return withLogging(logger, root)
51	}
52	
53	func (h *handler) handleHealthz(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
54		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
55		defer cancel()
56	
57		if err := h.store.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
58			h.logger.Error("healthz ping failed", "error", err)
59			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
60			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
61			w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"unhealthy"}`))
62			return
63		}
64	
65		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
66		w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok"}`))
67	}
68	
69	func withLogging(logger *slog.Logger, next http.Handler) http.Handler {
70		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
71			logger.Info("request",
72				"method", r.Method,
73				"path", r.URL.Path,
74				"remote", r.RemoteAddr,
75			)
76			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
77		})
78	}
